headline: Double-digit growth in both resilient and deal businesses
summary_short: Revenue rose 12.7% y/y to $11.5B, GAAP EPS was $1.52 (+25.6%) and Core EPS $2.05 (+28.1%), with core EBITDA up 28.5% to $1,001M.
summary_long: Advisory revenue grew 11% with global property sales up 28% and leasing up 6%; Building Operations & Experience revenue rose 17%. Free cash flow was $927M in the quarter including a $184M gain on real estate dispositions. The company repurchased nearly $1.2B of stock year to date. Net leverage was 1.36x and total liquidity was $5.0B. The release gives no numeric outlook.
confidence_notes: Prior-year revenue in the release ($10,221M) differs slightly from the shard's Yahoo-sourced y/y value ($10,258M); release figures used. Core EPS and Core EBITDA are non-GAAP. Free cash flow as defined by CBRE adds gains on real estate sales.

drivers.explanation: Growth came from both segments: Advisory up 11% and Building Operations & Experience up 17%, with infrastructure services a highlighted growth area.
Core EPS improved 28% on a 13% revenue increase, with resilient and transactional businesses both growing double digits.
Includes a $184 million gain on disposition of real estate versus $36 million a year ago, partly offset by higher capital expenditures.
